name: Custom
source: A strong fighter in his small village, Custom finds himself with the opportunity to compete in the Toushin Tournament when he rescues Kumiko from a group of Hannies. Wanting both the chance for glory and to help Kumiko find her father, Alexander, Custom travels to Toushin City, where he quickly finds himself outmatched by the world-class competitors.
